title: A bill to amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to extend the Administrative Fine Program for certain reporting violations.
official_summary: This act extends through December 31, 2033, the statutory authorization for the Federal Election Commission Administration Fine Program. This program provides expedited enforcement for late and nonfiled campaign finance disclosure reports.

summary.headline: Law extends the Federal Election Commission's program for fining late or missing campaign finance reports through 2033.
summary.what_it_does: This law extends the Federal Election Commission's Administrative Fine Program through December 31, 2033. The program lets the commission use a faster process to enforce rules when campaign finance disclosure reports are filed late or not filed at all.

who_it_affects.group: Political candidates' campaign committees, political parties, and PACs that must file reports with the Federal Election Commission
who_it_affects.how: They can continue to face fines through a faster enforcement process if they file required disclosure reports late or not at all.
The commission keeps its legal authority to run the expedited fine program for another decade.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 19, 2023; extends the program through December 31, 2033.
